title: Learn Only Where You Can't Compute: Structured Corrections to Gaussian Process Posteriors
abstract: arXiv:2610.21977v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Physics-informed Gaussian processes (GPs) provide a principled framework for scientific inference by expressing uncertainty over empirical measurements, boundary conditions, and governing equations. However, they struggle to scale to larger datasets and nonlinear information. Conversely, diffusion models excel at learning complex distributions over functions from massive datasets, but struggle in scientific contexts where training data are scarce and physical or observational information must be incorporated. We propose a structured posterior-correction framework that combines a tractable Gaussian reference with data-driven corrections via generative learning. After a mean correction and covariance calibration, a diffusion model learns a targeted correction in a low-dimensional subspace selected to capture discrepancies from the reference, while the complement retains its Gaussian law. translated_title: 只在无法计算之处学习：对高斯过程后验的结构化修正
translated_abstract: 物理信息高斯过程（GP）通过对经验测量、边界条件和控制方程进行不确定性建模，为科学推断提供了一个有原则的框架。然而，它们难以扩展到更大的数据集和非线性信息。相反，扩散模型擅长从海量数据中学习函数上的复杂分布，但在训练数据稀缺且必须融入物理或观测信息的科学场景中表现不佳。我们提出了一种结构化后验修正框架，将一个易于处理的高斯参考分布与通过生成学习实现的数据驱动修正相结合。在完成均值修正和协方差校准之后，扩散模型在一个经过挑选、用于捕捉与参考后验差异的低维子空间中学习有针对性的修正，而其补空间中的部分则保持高斯分布。在三个科学推断任务上，这些修正（此处原文被截断）
tldr: 提出一种结构化后验修正框架，在易处理的高斯参考基础上，由扩散模型仅在被选中的低维差异子空间中学习数据驱动的修正，从而兼顾高斯过程的可扩展性与扩散模型的表达能力，用于科学推断任务。
en_tdlr: A structured posterior-correction framework is proposed that combines a tractable Gaussian reference with diffusion-model-learned corrections confined to a low-dimensional discrepancy subspace, enabling scalable and flexible scientific inference.
